title.value: Answer job application questions from an uploaded resume

introduction.value: A commenter used AI to apply to about 300 jobs, uploading their resume to ChatGPT to answer application questions and editing the responses before submitting.

method.value: One commenter said they applied to 410 jobs after being fired, usually using one of two standard resumes and a mostly standard cover letter with the company name and job title swapped. When an application asked experience questions, they uploaded their resume to ChatGPT, pasted in the question, had it draft an answer using the resume as reference, then made minor edits before submitting; they said each application took under 10 minutes.

outcome.value: They eventually got hired for a job starting in December, after being fired in February. They said heavy tailoring and strong connections still often led nowhere, and that the role they landed was in an adjacent field where they had limited experience.

notes.value: Their main tradeoff was volume over customization: about 410 applications, usually under 10 minutes each.

Answer job application questions from an uploaded resume
A commenter used AI to apply to about 300 jobs, uploading their resume to ChatGPT to answer application questions and editing the responses before submitting.
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
One commenter said they applied to 410 jobs after being fired, usually using one of two standard resumes and a mostly standard cover letter with the company name and job title swapped. When an application asked experience questions, they uploaded their resume to ChatGPT, pasted in the question, had it draft an answer using the resume as reference, then made minor edits before submitting; they said each application took under 10 minutes.
How it went
They eventually got hired for a job starting in December, after being fired in February. They said heavy tailoring and strong connections still often led nowhere, and that the role they landed was in an adjacent field where they had limited experience.
Worth knowing
Their main tradeoff was volume over customization: about 410 applications, usually under 10 minutes each.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
Here is my resume: [paste resume]. I'm applying to [job title] at [company], and I'll paste the application questions one at a time. Draft honest answers in my voice using only what's in my resume, each under [word limit] words, and flag anything you can't answer from it so I can fill it in. I'll edit and submit myself, so don't send anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/fednews/comments/1p7pqt7/axed_feds_who_landed_a_new_job_any_tips
